one_liner: CRM platform with public REST API, OAuth, and hosted MCP server.

evidence.claim: REST API offers two credential types: OAuth 2.0 apps and single-workspace API keys
evidence.quote: You should prefer the OAuth 2.0 flow if building an app for multiple workspaces.

evidence.claim: Tokens are passed as Bearer in the Authorization header; HTTP Basic also supported
API keys are self-serve and available on every plan, generated by a workspace admin
Documented public REST API with full read/write access to the CRM data model
evidence.quote: Attio provides a public REST API which exchanges JSON over HTTPS.

evidence.claim: Official vendor-hosted MCP server for AI agents
evidence.quote: Attio MCP is Attio's hosted MCP server that gives AI tools secure access to your Attio workspace.

notes: Official hosted MCP at https://mcp.attio.com/mcp using OAuth with user-scoped permissions. App SDK additionally exposes a GraphQL API, but it is read-only and client-side only; server-side reads/writes use the REST API. Workspace API keys do not expire and must be created by a workspace admin; OAuth apps and scopes are configured self-serve in the Developer console at build.attio.com.
